scenes.summary: An agent rushed a mother and her daughter through a huge brownstone. The mother needed to move in within two weeks to prove to her soon-to-be ex-husband she could house their daughter.

beats.text: Bram, newly separated, must buy a home within 14 days to prove she can provide for her daughter
Agents show Bram and Hollis a huge four-floor brownstone with an elevator

humor.joke: the kid teaches mom to haggle

scenes.summary: Touring the floors, they learned the late owner was a paranoid, reclusive rich man whose heirs are suing because half of his fortune is missing.

beats.text: The late owner was a paranoid recluse whose missing millions have his heirs suing each other

scenes.summary: Bram noticed a strange corner; the agent revealed a hidden panic room with steel walls, a separate phone line, its own air and video monitors of the whole house. Bram found it unnerving; the door's safety sensor was demonstrated.

beats.text: A hidden panic room is revealed: steel walls, separate phone line, own ventilation, monitors on every room
Bram is uneasy about the claustrophobic room
The steel door has an infrared sensor that stops it closing on anything in its way

humor.joke: 'Ever read any Poe?' / 'I love her album' / 'The furniture guy?'

open_threads: Will the panic room be needed?

scenes.summary: On their first night, mother and daughter ordered pizza, vented about the ex-husband and his new partner, and the mother read to her daughter at bedtime.

beats.text: First night in the house: Bram and Hollis bond and share bitterness about the ex-husband

humor.joke: 'Fuck him.' 'Don't.' 'Fuck her too.' 'I agree. But don't.'

scenes.summary: Three burglars broke in at night and discovered the mother and daughter had already moved in because of an escrow mix-up. One wanted to quit since people were involved, while the planner insisted they could finish in 45 minutes; the third, an armed stranger, alarmed the others.

beats.text: Three burglars break in and find the house unexpectedly occupied by a woman and a child
Lena wants out because people are home; Rufus insists the job takes only 45 minutes
Rufus brought Milo, an unknown armed man, which alarms Lena

humor.joke: 'Fourteen days, that's almost three weeks' — business-day escrow logic

open_threads: What are they after? Will they harm the family?

cards.story_so_far: Newly separated Bram buys a Manhattan brownstone that once belonged to a paranoid millionaire whose missing fortune has his heirs suing; it contains a steel panic room with its own phone line, air and monitors. On the first night three burglars break in — planner Rufus, reluctant Lena who refuses to hurt people, and armed stranger Milo — and find Bram and her daughter Hollis already living there because of an escrow mistake.

roster_updates.name: Milo
roster_updates.who: armed gambler Rufus met 'at the tables'; volatile

scenes.summary: Rufus argued that keeping the family inside was not kidnapping and lured Lena back with fourteen million dollars hidden upstairs that would get him out of debt. They split up to grab the girl and the woman.

beats.text: Rufus reveals the prize: fourteen million dollars hidden upstairs, enough to clear Lena's debts
The burglars split up to seize the woman and the girl

humor.joke: 'You can't kidnap somebody in their own house' / 'third-generation idiot'

scenes.summary: Bram saw the intruders on the monitors, woke Hollis and they raced for the panic room as the burglars closed in, sealing the door just in time. The room's phone was dead because Bram had never connected it.

beats.text: Bram spots the intruders, grabs Hollis and they barely make it into the panic room
The panic room's separate phone line was never connected — they cannot call for help

moments.what: the race into the panic room

scenes.summary: Inside, Bram anxiously checked whether Hollis felt shaky or chilled, hinting at a medical condition.

beats.text: Bram checks Hollis for shakiness and chills — a hidden medical condition is planted

scenes.summary: Over the intercom the burglars told them to leave; Bram bluffed that police were coming. A sign was held up: what they wanted was inside the room. Coached by Hollis, Bram shouted at them to get out of her house.

beats.text: The burglars reveal that what they want is inside the panic room itself
Bram bluffs about the police and, coached by Hollis, defiantly refuses to come out

humor.joke: daughter coaches mom to swear: 'Say fuck.'

moments.what: 'Get the fuck out of my house!'

scenes.summary: The burglars bickered; Lena, who spent ten years building such rooms for a living, said nobody can get in, so the woman must be forced out. They decided to seal the house so the family could not escape.

beats.text: Lena turns out to be a builder of panic rooms who knows they cannot break in, so they must force the family out
They seal the house and refuse to let Milo hover with his gun

humor.joke: Milo laughs at God's sense of irony

scenes.summary: Bram began panicking in the small space; Hollis distracted her with a joke. When the intruders sealed them in, Bram lost it and Hollis screamed at her to stay present until she recovered.

beats.text: Claustrophobic Bram has a panic attack; Hollis pulls her back

humor.joke: 'Why did the chicken cross the road? To prove he wasn't chicken.'

moments.what: Hollis screams her mother out of a panic attack

scenes.summary: Rufus pumped gas into the room's vents to drive them out; Lena protested they would die and could not get in if the pair passed out. Rufus raged that he was coming in.

beats.text: Rufus pumps gas into the room to force them out, over Lena's objections

humor.joke: 'how are we supposed to get into the room if they pass out?' 'Oh.'

moments.what: gas fills the room, they cough

open_threads: How will they survive the gas?

scenes.summary: Bram flashed SOS in Morse code at a neighbor, who ignored it. Meanwhile Rufus and Lena argued over splitting the fourteen million.

Rufus and Lena quarrel over shares of the money

cards.story_so_far: Newly separated Bram and her daughter Hollis move into a brownstone with a steel panic room. On the first night, three burglars — planner Rufus, panic-room builder Lena, and armed gambler Milo — break in for fourteen million dollars hidden inside the panic room. Bram and Hollis make it into the room, but its phone was never connected. The burglars seal the house and pump gas into the vents; Hollis talks her claustrophobic mother through a panic attack, Bram's SOS to a neighbor is ignored, and the thieves start fighting over shares. Hollis seems to have a medical condition.

roster_updates.name: Stephen
roster_updates.who: Bram's estranged husband, Hollis's father, lives across the park

scenes.summary: Arguing over shares, Rufus revealed it is his own family he is robbing — the safe was his grandfather's — and insisted they need Lena to open it as Milo threatened him.

beats.text: Rufus is the late owner's grandson, stealing from his own family's estate
Milo threatens Lena; Rufus says they cannot open the safe without Lena

humor.joke: Rufus mocks Milo's gangster talk: 'You're a bus driver... you live in Flatbush'

scenes.summary: While the burglars were distracted, Bram dashed out of the panic room to her bedroom and grabbed her cell phone, making it back just in time — but there was no signal inside the room.

beats.text: Bram risks a dash out of the room to grab her cell phone and makes it back
The cell phone gets no signal inside the steel room

moments.what: 'If I can't get back, close the door' — the dash

scenes.summary: Bram remembered the house's main phone line ran by the room and spliced into its wires; meanwhile the burglars realized Rufus never cut the main line. She reached 911 but was put on hold and lost the line.

beats.text: Bram splices into the main phone line and reaches 911, but is put on hold and cut off

scenes.summary: They called Hollis's father, but the line was garbled; Bram insisted he would come because they still are a family. Hollis confessed she had been hiding that she was dizzy and thirsty.

beats.text: A garbled call reaches Hollis's father; Bram insists he will come to help
Hollis admits she is dizzy and thirsty — her blood sugar is crashing

scenes.summary: Bram realized Hollis, a diabetic, needed sugar or her Glucagon shot, which was in the fridge in Hollis's room outside. Meanwhile Rufus gave up and tried to quit with a payout, but Milo declared nobody leaves and he would open the safe.

beats.text: Hollis is diabetic; her emergency Glucagon injection is outside the room, in her bedroom fridge
Rufus tries to quit; Milo declares nobody leaves

humor.joke: 'I'm dizzy, not deaf.' 'Still a smart ass, excellent sign.'

moments.what: mother and daughter calm each other about the attack

scenes.summary: When Rufus tried to walk out, Milo violently stopped him, apparently shooting him, then held Lena at gunpoint and forced him to come up with a way into the room.

beats.text: Milo violently stops Rufus from leaving (apparently shooting him) and seizes control
At gunpoint, Lena is forced to find a way into the room

scenes.setting_guess: house, in view of the room's monitors
scenes.summary: Hollis's father arrived and was captured; the burglars beat him in front of the monitors to make Bram open the door. Hollis screamed for her daddy, Bram refused, Lena protested, and Hollis began to slip into a diabetic attack.

beats.text: The father arrives and is captured; the burglars beat him on camera to force the door open
Hollis goes into a diabetic attack and begs her mother for the injection

open_threads: Will Bram leave the room for the Glucagon?

cards.story_so_far: Bram and her diabetic daughter Hollis are trapped in a panic room while three burglars hunt for fourteen million dollars in a safe inside it: Rufus (the dead owner's grandson), Lena (a panic-room builder) and volatile Milo. Gas, a cellphone dash and a spliced 911 call fail; a garbled call reaches the father. Hollis's blood sugar crashes and her Glucagon is outside the room. Milo violently takes control from Rufus and forces Lena to find a way in; the father arrives, is captured and beaten on camera to make Bram open the door, as Hollis slips into a diabetic attack.

roster_updates.name: Police officers
roster_updates.who: officers responding to the father's call

scenes.setting_guess: inside the panic room (burglars now inside with Hollis); Bram outside on the intercom
scenes.summary: The positions had flipped: the burglars were now inside the panic room with Hollis while Bram, outside, screamed that her daughter needed her medicine. Learning that without the injection Hollis could fall into a coma and die, Lena decided to give her the shot himself despite Milo.

beats.text: Positions flip: the burglars are locked in the panic room with Hollis while Bram is outside with the medicine
Told Hollis could fall into a coma and die, Lena insists on giving her the injection

scenes.summary: Lena gave Hollis the shot while confessing he was a desperate gambler who had lost his house, car and wife; Hollis recovered, and Milo sneered that he had only saved her for ten minutes.

beats.text: Lena injects Hollis and saves her, confessing that gambling debts drove him to crime
Milo: 'You saved her life for ten minutes' — he means to kill her

moments.what: Lena's bad-cards confession while saving the girl

scenes.summary: Police arrived after the father's call. Watched on the monitors by the burglars holding her daughter, Bram convinced the officers nothing was wrong with an embarrassing lie about a drunk call to her ex, and they left.

beats.text: Police arrive, but with her daughter held hostage Bram lies and sends them away

humor.joke: the 'three things I'll do for you' cover story

moments.what: officer offers a secret signal; Bram declines

scenes.summary: Milo announced the witnesses must die — the kid now, the other two later — and Lena refused; the safe was finally being opened.

beats.text: Milo plans to kill all three witnesses; Lena refuses
The safe is opened

scenes.summary: In the chaotic finale someone broke through a wall from the neighbor's house; Bram turned the burglars' own gun on them, and Lena grabbed the money and ran as Milo shouted after him. (Physical action is largely absent from the dialogue; details are inferred.)

beats.text: Final showdown: Bram gets hold of the gun and fights back
Lena grabs the money and flees

humor.joke: 'WHO BREAKS IN THROUGH THE NEIGHBOR'S HOUSE?!'

open_threads: Do they survive? Does Lena escape?

scenes.summary: Police ordered someone, apparently the fleeing Lena, to put their hands up.

beats.text: Police order the fleeing burglar to put his hands up

scenes.summary: Later, mother and daughter browsed real-estate listings and wondered where they would live now.

beats.text: Epilogue: safe, mother and daughter look for a new place to live

humor.joke: house-hunting again after the house from hell

cards.story_so_far: Bram and her diabetic daughter Hollis hide in a panic room from burglars Rufus, Lena and Milo, who want fourteen million dollars in its safe. After failed calls for help, Hollis's sugar crashes; Milo takes control and the captured father is beaten. Positions flip: the burglars end up inside the room with Hollis while Bram has the medicine; Lena saves Hollis with the injection. Bram sends the police away to protect her daughter. Milo plans to kill all witnesses; in the final fight Bram turns the gun on him, Lena runs with the money and is stopped by police. Later mother and daughter look for a new home.
